name: Main Street Research
description: Main Street Research describes itself as a wealth management firm providing financial planning and investment management to individuals, families, foundations, and institutions.
pricingDetail: The firm publishes asset-based fees and an alternative combining management and performance fees. These are wealth management fees; the reviewed sources do not substantiate per-call expert-network pricing.

compliance.mnpiPolicy: The March 31, 2026 Form ADV brochure says the firm's employee Code of Ethics prohibits the use of material non-public information.

overview:
The website previously linked from this record redirects to Main Street Research, whose public materials describe wealth management. The reviewed sources do not establish the previously claimed expert-network business. This record is unpublished pending editorial review of its inclusion.

The firm says it was founded in 1993. Its March 2026 brochure lists Lakeville, Connecticut as headquarters, with offices in Sausalito, New York, and Greenwich. A team biography still describes Sausalito as headquarters, so the location above is explicitly tied to the brochure date.

history.narrative: Main Street Research dates its founding to 1993. Recent disclosures and an appointment announcement concern its wealth management business.

timeline.event: The firm's history dates its founding as an investment adviser to this year.
The firm's Form ADV brochure reports approximately $2.68 billion managed on a discretionary basis as of December 31, 2025.
The firm announced Benjamin Armellini's appointment as Chief Executive Officer.

servicesDetailed.name: Wealth Planning
servicesDetailed.description: The firm describes financial planning for clients' assets, spending, retirement, and estate circumstances.

servicesDetailed.name: Investment Management
servicesDetailed.description: The firm describes managing portfolios of individual securities according to clients' objectives and risk tolerance.

servicesDetailed.name: Institutional Wealth Management
servicesDetailed.description: The firm markets investment and governance support to foundations, nonprofits, endowments, and retirement plans.

clientFit.narrative: The firm's stated clients include individuals and families, corporate executives, foundations, nonprofits, and endowments.
segments: Individuals and families seeking wealth management

caveats: Editorial assessment: the reviewed materials describe wealth management and do not substantiate an expert-network offering.
Expert counts, expert-call pricing, channel checks, AI research tools, and expert-network compliance controls were not established by the reviewed sources.
